title: Slow Setup Relief — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Early Closure Terms
content:
**Relief clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service activated more than 14 calendar days after its enrolled date, counting the activated date but not the enrolled date, earns 10 percent relief on the early closure fee, one activated more than 7 but no more than 14 days after it earns 5 percent, and any other service earns no setup relief.

The enrolled date and the activated date are the dates on the service record.

| Calendar days from enrollment to activation | Setup relief |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | 10 percent |
| 8 to 14 | 5 percent |
| 7 or fewer | none |

**Basis questions (hypothetical dates, enrolled on the 3rd of a month).**

*Activated on the 17th?* 14 days: more than 7 but not more than 14, so 5 percent.

*Activated on the 18th?* 15 days: more than 14, so 10 percent.

*Activated on the 10th?* 7 days: not more than 7, so no setup relief.

*Activated on the 11th?* 8 days: 5 percent.
